cast.name: 丽安娜·贝黛维 Liana Bdéwi

introduction: The girl Sonya discovers that if you attach magnets from the refrigerator to a bread bin and eat toast with jam, you can get to the magical city of Toastville, which is located on the planet Toastland. The fantasy world consists of two halves of toast: funny creatures Toastly live on the light side, and the insidious Crumbles live on the dark side. Unusual events often happen in Toastville, and Sonya is helped to save the inhabitants of the city by new friends: Maya the fried egg, Nick the apple core, Muffy the talking cupcake, and little people Bee and Bo. At the end of each day, the girl shares stories about her adventures with subscribers.
